turns.speaker: Priya
turns.role: Science Documentary Host · South Asian English
turns.text: Welcome to the OpenIE Knowledge Desk on OpenIE Research Radio! I'm Priya, joined by Sean and Claire — three AI-synthesized OpenIE research personas voiced via ElevenLabs studio neural voices and grounded strictly in verified Open Interface Engineering studies. Today we open knowledge.openie.dev: seven-axis time claims and the Lean 4.36.0 six-kernel audit.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.role: Science Documentary Host · South Asian English
turns.text: Picture how internet rumor laundering works: one blog invents a number, three sites quote the blog, and a chatbot cites all three as consensus! Or imagine a medical chart overwriting Tuesday's blood draw on Friday without separating when the lab happened from when the edit happened.

turns.speaker: Sean
turns.text: Bare English sentences strip away clocks, scope, and primary sources! Claire, how does knowledge.openie.dev make citation laundering impossible?

turns.speaker: Claire
turns.role: Formal Verification & Silicon Architect · British English
turns.text: Every claim carries seven explicit coordinates, Sean: Valid Time in reality, Transaction Time in the ledger, Reference Time for the horizon frame, Granularity, Scope, Certainty — T, E, M, or S — and Anti-Laundering Provenance collapsing circular citations back to primary cryptographic digests.

turns.speaker: Sean
turns.text: Now test badge T — kernel-checked proofs! Why didn't we stop at one Lean build instead of locking six rival proof checkers inside Linux bubblewrap?

turns.speaker: Claire
turns.role: Formal Verification & Silicon Architect · British English
turns.text: Imagine certifying a jet wing with six independent inspectors from different countries inside a sealed room with no internet! In 2026, real Lean 4 soundness bugs — CVE-2026-72844 projection confusion, CVE-2026-72711 in add_opaque, binary cache replay, and compiler-trust ofReduceBool — proved why no single binary should grade its own homework.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.role: Science Documentary Host · South Asian English
turns.text: How many OpenIE theorem constants pass that sealed bubblewrap audit?

turns.speaker: Claire
turns.role: Formal Verification & Silicon Architect · British English
turns.text: Five thousand four hundred ninety-six theorem constants — five thousand three hundred ninety-three in RCE, forty-five in Communication Avalanche, thirty-one in Time as an Index, and twenty-seven in Downward LUT6 Compilation — with zero sorry, zero custom axioms, zero opaque, and zero ofReduceBool!

turns.speaker: Sean
turns.text: Name all six independent checkers at the table!

turns.speaker: Claire
turns.role: Formal Verification & Silicon Architect · British English
turns.text: Joachim Breitner's minimal con-leche proved consistent in ZFC set theory; con-ron, its Aeneas-verified Rust refinement; Mario Carneiro's Lean-in-Lean checker lean4lean; nanoda in standalone Rust blocking sorryAx; fresh-environment leanchecker dash-dash paranoid; and the post-CVE Lean 4.36.0 C-plus-plus kernel!

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.role: Science Documentary Host · South Asian English
turns.text: Connect that Reference-Time coordinate to horizon.openie.dev and Time as an Index!

turns.speaker: Claire
turns.role: Formal Verification & Silicon Architect · British English
turns.text: Those six-kernel proofs show why only Shannon one-time pads survive a mathematical PSPACE time loop, while in known physics every fast lookup is Hellman precomputation paid ahead of time — dropping from thirty-four percent reuse to zero percent the instant a fresh query-time salt arrives!

turns.speaker: Sean
turns.text: And how did anti-laundering provenance treat unproved RCE draft clauses and famous time-travel stories?

turns.speaker: Claire
turns.role: Formal Verification & Silicon Architect · British English
turns.text: Twelve unproved Appendix F statements in RCE Draft 0.9 stay strictly segregated from proved theorems, and across eighty-one audited time anomalies, Rudolph Fentz traced to 1951 fiction and superluminal neutrinos to a seventy-three-nanosecond loose cable — leaving zero unexplained future signals!

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.role: Science Documentary Host · South Asian English
turns.text: Stamp every claim with its three clocks and check proofs across six independent kernels! Visit knowledge.openie.dev, and join Cecily, Marcus, and Kwame next at the OpenIE Database and Data Desk!
